# PRD — Producer Earnings Report
**Epic:** EP-05

| ID | Feature | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| F-05.1 | Producer views monthly earnings summary | Committed |
| F-05.2 | Producer exports earnings as CSV | Committed |

Roles: PRODUCER (own earnings only), ADMIN (all producers).
NFR-1 Report P95 ≤ 800 ms. NFR-2 A producer can never see another producer's earnings.
Owner: Payouts squad.
parameters.platform_architecture:
# Platform — Producer Earnings Report
earnings-report-api: Java 17 / Spring Boot 3, `eclipse-temurin:17-jre-alpine`, port 8082, 250m/1000m CPU, 256Mi/512Mi, probe /actuator/health, on EKS namespace payouts, HPA 2-4, behind the shared ALB (TLS 1.3). Already deployed to production in Cycle 5 — target = current build.
producer-portal: existing React app; new Earnings page only.
Auth: Cognito RS256 JWT via AuthFilter (EA-05). RBAC: GET /v1/earnings and GET /v1/earnings/export — PRODUCER own producerId forced server-side; ADMIN any producer.
Observability: JSON logs with correlation id, Micrometer → Prometheus, /actuator/health. OpenTelemetry tracing not yet added.
Load test LT-12 (Cycle 5): report P95 610 ms at 50 rps.
parameters.data_architecture:
# Data — Producer Earnings Report
Read-only. Reads the `orders` schema on the PostgreSQL RDS read replica (KMS encrypted at rest, EA-04). No writes, no entities with a lifecycle owned by this module. No cache.
parameters.integration_architecture:
# Integration — Producer Earnings Report
No external systems. No events produced or consumed.
